content:
Where a RETURNED payment has `refund_minor` equal to its original amount, the full principal has been credited. The payment-return event records the status and cash change together. New-payment fees remain separate.

Other returns may have a smaller refund amount. RETURN_PENDING is not yet cash, and a returned payment does not cancel another transfer against the same obligation. Use each transfer's actual refund or settlement record.

title: A bank return for the full principal
